sql: WITH female_clients AS (SELECT c.client_id, c.birth_date, dt.A11 FROM client c JOIN district dt ON c.district_id = dt.district_id WHERE c.gender = 'F'), target AS (SELECT client_id FROM female_clients WHERE A11 = (SELECT MIN(A11) FROM female_clients) AND birth_date = (SELECT MIN(birth_date) FROM female_clients WHERE A11 = (SELECT MIN(A11) FROM female_clients))) SELECT d.account_id, (SELECT MAX(A11) - MIN(A11) FROM district) AS salary_gap FROM disp d JOIN target t ON d.client_id = t.client_id;
